title: FoxList
body:
![Photo By FoxDreams](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6094b688862bb12f53a644f6ed5eaa46bba2f72.png)

**FoxList** is a powerful plugin that can replace your standard WhiteList. Not only does it have all the features of this tool, but it also offers WebHook support, which opens up a lot of possibilities for customizing your browser. At the moment, this is just a beta version of the plugin, but we promise to add even more features in the future.

**The plugin was successfully tested on versions 1.21-1.21.5**

### Plugin Commands

- /fwl add [nickname] — Add the user to the list
- /fwl remove [nickname] — Remove the user from the list
- /fwl list — Show the list of participants
- /fwl on-Enable WhiteList
- /fwl off-Disable WhiteList
- /fwl webhook on-Enable WebHook
- /fwl webhook off-Disable WebHook
- /fwl reload — Reload the plugin

### Plugin Rights

- foxlist. admin — Access to each plugin command
